name: Satyr Slaying!
summary: At the Shrine of Aessina, Illiyana asks Alliance champions to strike at the satyrs of Ashenvale. Grieving her sister Anilia, she seeks vengeance and asks you to bring back satyr horns as proof.

sections.title: A Dryad's Grief
sections.body: Anilia's death has left Illiyana in grief at the Shrine of Aessina. Dryads are forest spirits bonded to nature, often playful and serene, and elusive to mortals. Anilia's brutal slaying shattered that calm for her sister. Illiyana now turns to Alliance travelers to strike down the demonic beasts responsible.

sections.title: The Corrupted Kin
sections.body: Satyrs were once night elves, but demonic energy corrupted them during the War of the Ancients. They lurk in defiled groves across Ashenvale and prey on the woods' inhabitants as servants of the Burning Legion. Bringing Illiyana their horns gives proof of vengeance and strikes at the fel presence encroaching on eastern Ashenvale.

faq.answer: Illiyana is a dryad who lives at the Shrine of Aessina in Ashenvale. Gentle by nature, she mourns her sister Anilia, who was slain by local satyrs.
Anilia was a dryad and Illiyana's beloved sister. They spent ages among Ashenvale's ancient canopies until satyrs ambushed and killed Anilia.

faq.q: Why does Illiyana ask for satyr horns?
faq.answer: Illiyana asks for satyr horns as proof that the creatures who killed Anilia have been slain. She hopes this will bring her sister's spirit peace.

aliases: what are the satyrs in ashenvale
faq.answer: Satyrs are night elves corrupted and changed by the Burning Legion's demonic powers during the War of the Ancients. They dwell in corrupted enclaves, spreading taint and destroying forest spirits.
Forest Song is an ancient, nearly abandoned night elf ruin in far eastern Ashenvale, near the border of Azshara. Illiyana waits at the Shrine of Aessina, not at Forest Song.

faq.q: Is this connected to any other hunts?
faq.answer: Illiyana continues to accept satyr horns after Anilia is avenged. Ashenvale's defenders are still working to drive the satyrs from the forest.

angles.text: As a druid, avenging a fallen dryad and taking the horns of demonic satyrs strikes at the corruption in Cenarius's favored wilderness.
As a night elf, you know satyrs as a shameful reminder of the Highborne's ancient fall into fel servitude. Helping Illiyana cleanses the land of this ancestral blight.
As an Alliance champion, you help thin the satyr ranks and make Ashenvale's forest safer from the wild threats around you.
